sections.content_text: Section 2 Clause 60 - Fair Market Value “Fair Market Value” means— (a) Where agricultural produce is sold in the general market in its raw state or is processed and made fit for sale through a farmer engaged in production, the tax shall be assessed in the first year on the income arising from the produce at the price at which it was sold during the entire preceding year its average value; and (b) in cases where the said apicultural produce is not normally sold in the raw state in the market, the amount of the following sums:- (i) cost of cultivation; (ii) land development tax or rent on which the produce is grown; and (iii) the rate of profit reasonably determined by the Commissioner of Taxes on the sale price of the disputed as agricultural produce taking into account the circumstances; Moreover, as per
